title: SolAgents Agentic Commerce
summary: Initialize the platform, create and fund an SPL job escrow, let the provider submit, and have the evaluator complete so the provider is paid (minus a 0.5% fee).
what: SolAgents agentic_commerce is an Anchor 0.31.1 job escrow (EIP-8183-style) with client, provider and evaluator roles. This lesson covers initialize, create_job, set_budget, fund, submit and complete. bonding_curve was not deployed.
app_note: The page at /dapps/solagents-commerce/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/solagents-programs. Only declare_id for agentic_commerce was changed to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/solagents-commerce/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran initialize → create_job → set_budget → fund → submit → complete with 1_000_000 units of the lab mint.
try_steps.see: Program GXskCGB6…. Config tU8ugVHK… (fee 50 bps). Job C3VwDTjN… should be Completed; vault CheoMeAu… empty; provider +995_000, treasury +5_000.

diagram: admin --initialize--> config ["config"] ; client --create_job--> job ["job", config, job_id] + vault ["vault", job] ; client --set_budget/fund--> vault ; provider --submit--> Submitted ; evaluator --complete--> provider 99.5% + treasury 0.5%
accounts: vault (SPL token account PDA, seeds ["vault", job], authority = job)
instructions: reject / claim_refund / close_job / admin ixs exist in the IDL but were not exercised
innovation: A three-role job escrow (client, provider, evaluator) with a job-owned SPL vault and an optional hook program.
exercises: Fetch job C3VwDTjN… and confirm status is Completed.
Explain why the vault can be debited on complete (authority is the job PDA).
Sketch how claim_refund would work after expiry.
not_covered: reject, claim_refund, close_job, hooks, set_provider after create, and the bonding_curve program were not exercised.
objectives: Identify buyer, seller, and settlement accounts in the commerce program.
Execute one recorded purchase/settlement path on Devnet.
Explain what evidence proves the payment settled.
prereqs: A Devnet wallet with practice SOL/tokens for the lesson mint.
student_outcome: Complete one commerce job to Completed and explain why the vault debit is authorized by the job PDA.

learning_loop.objective: Inspect a Completed job — then explain job-PDA vault authority on complete.
learning_loop.predict_question: On complete, SPL tokens leave the job vault. What authorizes that debit?

predict_options.label: Only the buyer wallet signature moves vault tokens directly
The job PDA is the vault authority; the program signs as the job PDA
The provider can always drain the vault

learning_loop.predict_why: SolAgents vault authority is the job PDA. complete debits via program-signed PDA authority — not by treating buyer/provider wallets as the vault owner.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/solagents-commerce/ on Devnet. Fetch job C3VwDTjN… (Completed). Prefer recorded initialize → create_job → set_budget → … → complete proofs. Note reject/claim_refund/hooks not exercised.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why must complete sign as the job PDA to debit the vault?
learning_loop.transfer: Name one Completed-job check and one not_covered path (claim_refund after expiry).
